$comment: Flow guards, dogfooded on Beadloom itself (BDL-061 S1).
The hook carries NO logic: it pipes the harness event to `beadloom guard`,
which reads the declarations, strictness and exclusions from .beadloom/flow.yml.
Adding or retiring a guard is therefore a flow.yml edit, not a settings edit —
except for the guard NAME below, which is the one coupling still present and is
recorded as a finding for the S1 review bead.
Exit codes map to the harness by design: 0 pass/skip, 1 warn (surfaced, not
blocking), 2 block. Both guards ship at `warn`, so nothing here stops work today;
they report, and they name what they did not check.
